turns.content: Raat ke do baje hain aur main abhi bhi office mein hoon. Kaam nahi kar raha — bas baitha hoon. Bridge round Tuesday ko officially mar gaya. Rohit aur Sneha ne is hafte papers daal diye, jo honestly, sahi kiya. Chaar mahine ka runway hai agar main salary na loon, jo already nahi le raha. Paanch saal lagaye hain maine is cheez mein.

Yeh kafi mushkil lag raha hai. Paanch saal kaafi lamba samay hai, aur aisa lagta hai jaise sab kuch ruk gaya ho. Bridge round ka na hona ek bada blow hai. Kya soch rahe ho ab? Koi plan hai aage badhne ke liye?

Sabse bura part performance hai yaar. Har standup pe main ek voice nikal raha hoon — confident wala, "kuch cheezein pipeline mein hain" — aur sabko pata hai. Co-founder ko pata hai. Jo do junior ruke hain unko pakka pata hai, woh loyalty ki wajah se ruke hain aur main unke career jala raha hoon. Ghar pe alag voice hai. Apni hi awaazon se thak gaya hoon main.

Yeh to aur bhi mushkil ho gaya. Apni hi awaazon se thak jana kaafi emotional strain hai. Jab bahar wali image banane ke liye andar se har roz jhooth bolna padta hai, to woh andar hi andar khaali kar deta hai. Co-founder ko pata hona aur junior logon ka loyalty ke liye rukna, yeh responsibility kaafi bhaari ho gayi hai. Kya tumne kabhi socha hai ki apni asli feelings ko share karna chahiye, kam se kam un logon ke saath jo tumhare saath directly involved hain?

Please mujhe ideas mat dena. Saare ideas pata hain mujhe. Har pivot thread padh chuka hoon, down-round wala email chhe baar draft kar chuka hoon, bridge financing, acquihire, "revenue pe focus" — sab pata hai. Bas kahin toh bolna tha: mujhe darr lag raha hai, aur jis bhi kamre mein main hota hoon wahan yeh nahi bol sakta.

Theek hai, main samajh gaya. Bas sunne ke liye hoon yahan. Lagta hai jaise tum apne darr aur emotions ko express karne ke liye kisi safe space ki talaash mein hain. Main hoon wahan, bas suna raha hoon. Kuch kehne ki zarurat nahi, bas jo mann mein aaye, bol do. Main yahan hoon.

Khatam ho gaya kya? Sach mein — honestly bol sakte ho. Paanch saal. Papa aaj bhi logon ko bolte hain mera "computer ka business" hai. Kabhi kabhi raat ko lagta hai bas khatam ho jaye toh acting band kar sakoon, aur phir yeh sochne ke liye khud se nafrat hoti hai. Phir wapas metrics dashboard khol leta hoon jaise woh do baje kuch naya bolega.

Yeh bahut intimate baat hai. Lagta hai jaise andar se sab kuch toot gaya ho. Paanch saal lagana aur phir aisa lagna jaise sab khatam ho gaya, yeh kaafi dardnaak hai. Apne papa ke saamne apni asli haalat chhipana aur unhe apni success story sunana, yeh bhi kaafi pressure daalta hai. Raat ko aise sochna aur phir apne aap se nafrat hona, yeh emotional turmoil kaafi intense hai. Metrics dashboard ko dekhne ka mann hona, jaise woh koi jawab de dega, yeh bhi ek tarah ka helplessness dikhata hai. Bas suna, aur samjha.
